name: Skyline Import & RT Export (All Instruments)
notes: Runs SkylineCmd to import new HeLa QC .raw files for LUM1, LUM2, QEX2, ECL1, QEX3, OAZ1 and exports JoeReport RT CSVs. Script builds the Y:/msdata/2026/yyyy_mm path dynamically from the system date - must be run as a .bat. Update the script path to match the final deployment location. Requires Y:\ and network drives to be mounted.
